pkgmetadata.longdescription:
qmd (Quick Markdown Search) indexes markdown collections into a SQLite index and supports BM25, vector and hybrid retrieval with re-ranking.
This localrepo package is built from the joewis fork of upstream 2.8.3, which adds an optional models.remote: block so that embeddings and re-ranking can be served by a cloud endpoint. A remote failure skips the affected layer rather than substituting the local model, so a provider outage degrades result quality, not availability or latency.
It ships as a prepared runtime bundle (dist plus production node_modules) and installs to the same path a global npm install used, so existing wrappers and systemd units keep working.
